title: CONSINTBENCH: EVALUATING LANGUAGE MODELS ON REAL-WORLD CONSUMER INTENT UNDERSTANDING

bias_targets.methodology: Implementing a retrieval-augmented generation (CONSINT-RAG) pipeline to retrieve actual consumer preferences as ground truth, mitigating the inherent evaluation bias and hallucinations introduced when relying solely on an LLM-as-a-judge mechanism.

Evaluating the 'Correctness' dimension by comparing the LLM-generated answers against top-k relevant real-world discussions to determine if the model's understanding systematically deviates from or misrepresents the true consensus and sentiments of human consumers.
